description: This file contains common utility functions and scripts used during system upgrade processes, including file installation, hook execution, image handling, partition parsing, and upgrade procedures. It appears to be part of a larger upgrade framework for embedded or Linux-based systems.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies files to a target directory within RAM_ROOT, handling symbolic links and creating directories as needed.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Installs a binary file, copying it along with its linked libraries if executable.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Executes a list of hook functions with a provided argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no answer with a default choice, returning true or false.

methods.name: _v
methods.description: Logs verbose messages if verbosity level is set.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs an informational message regarding the upgrade process.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON encoding.

methods.name: rootfs_type
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem type by inspecting mount points.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Outputs the contents of a source file, possibly decompressing based on magic bytes.

methods.name: get_image_dd
methods.description: Streams image data from a file, piping through dd with diagnostic filtering.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads the magic word (header bytes) for file type identification.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte magic value to identify the image format.

methods.name: get_magic_gpt
methods.description: Checks for GPT partition table signature.

methods.name: get_magic_vfat
methods.description: Checks for FAT filesystem signature.

methods.name: get_magic_fat32
methods.description: Checks for FAT32 filesystem signature.

methods.name: identify_magic_long
methods.description: Identifies image types based on long magic values.

methods.name: part_magic_efi
methods.description: Checks for EFI partition magic.

methods.name: part_magic_fat
methods.description: Checks for FAT or FAT32 magic.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Identifies and exports the boot device based on kernel command line parameters.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports partition device name based on BOOTDEV variables.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts a 4-byte little-endian hex string to CPU byte order.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads partition table from a device file, identifies partitions, and writes mapping info.

methods.name: indicate_upgrade
methods.description: Sets system state to 'upgrade' by sourcing diag.sh and invoking set_state.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade by copying the image to a flash partition via mtd commands, handling backups and decompression.
